name: Lion’s Mane
summary: Lion's mane (Hericium erinaceus) is an edible mushroom studied for cognition, mood, and nerve-growth-related mechanisms. Human evidence remains early and product-specific, so fruiting-body, mycelium, and isolated-compound findings should not be treated as interchangeable or as proof of disease prevention.
description: Traditional herbal medicine with emerging evidence supporting therapeutic applications.
safetyNotes: Generally well tolerated when used appropriately; review interactions and contraindications.
